select t.* , if (t.subno = '22210101', t.subno,null) additionalTaxCityBuild , if (t.subno = '22210102', t.subno,null) educationFeePlus , if (t.subno = '22210102', t.subno,null) localEducationFeePlus , if (t.subno = '22210102', t.subno,null) interestIncomeTax , if (t.subno = '22210102', t.subno,null) dividendTax , if (t.subno = '22210102', t.subno,null) spreadIncomeTax from (select SUBJECT_NO subno, format(BALANCE_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %h:%i:%s') as valDate, (SELECT b.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID FROM BOK_BOOKSET b where b.BOOKSET_ID = BOK_BALANCE.BOOKSET_ID) AS prodId, O_AMT cost from BOK_BALANCE where
BOOKSET_ID in #{item, jdbcType = VARCHAR} and BALANCE_DATE = #{exeDate, jdbcType = TIMESTAMP} and SUBJECT_NO IN ('22210101', '22210102', '22210103', '22210801', '22210802', '22210803') order by O_AMT desc) t
